add_light.title: Add a reset light
add_light.description: Reset the light first (switch it off and on 3 times: it blinks). Lights waiting for keys are searched through the Bluetooth adapters and proxies of Home Assistant. The light receives the keys of this mesh network and an address in 0x7E00–0x7EFF; it will not appear in the Nordlux app.

firmware.title: Firmware updates
firmware.description:
Credentials saved: {state}

To know whether a newer firmware is published, the integration logs in to your Nordlux account once a day (read-only). The email and password are stored in Home Assistant (unencrypted, like other integration credentials). Installation is then done from each light's « Firmware » update entity.

proxies_unreachable.title: Nordlux: no Bluetooth proxy available
proxies_unreachable.description:
For about {minutes} minutes, Home Assistant has had no connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy, so the Nordlux lights cannot be reached ({error}).

Check the ESPHome Bluetooth proxy: powered, connected to Wi-Fi and to Home Assistant.

This alert disappears as soon as a read succeeds.

bulb_in_bootloader.title: Nordlux: « {name} » is stuck in update mode
bulb_in_bootloader.description:
The light « {name} » ({address}) is advertising its update bootloader instead of its normal firmware: an earlier firmware update was interrupted, so the light stays off and does not respond.

To repair it, open its « Firmware » entity (device page or Settings → Updates) and click « Install »: the latest published firmware is downloaded and flashed through the Bluetooth proxy (about 5 minutes; keep the proxy close to the light).

This alert disappears as soon as the light is back to normal operation.

bulb_in_bootloader_no_credentials.title: Nordlux: « {name} » is stuck in update mode
bulb_in_bootloader_no_credentials.description:
The light « {name} » ({address}) is advertising its update bootloader instead of its normal firmware: an earlier firmware update was interrupted, so the light stays off and does not respond.

To repair it, the firmware must be downloaded from the Nordlux account: first save your credentials in Configure → « Firmware updates (Nordlux account) », then, about one minute later, click « Install » on the light's « Firmware » entity.

This alert disappears as soon as the light is back to normal operation.
